result.text:
## Incident Response Task: Kafka Cluster Partition Leader Rebalance Failure During Traffic Surge

**Incident:** Critical operational post-mortem and mitigation plan for the Kafka cluster partition leader rebalance failure during yesterday's traffic surge.

**Scope:** Review the Kafka cluster partition leader rebalance failure during the traffic surge.

**Preparation:**
- Examine server.properties in the config directory to confirm that auto-leader-rebalance-enable is set to true and verify that leader-imbalance-per-broker-percentage is configured to 0.01%.
- Inspect kafka-core/partition_assignor.java and cluster-manager/controller.py to confirm that the primary root cause was an unexpected network partition between availability zones us-east-1a and us-east-1b, causing 24 brokers to simultaneously trigger leader elections across 2000 partitions.
- Verify that the cascading election phase message production halted because min-insync-replicas was set to 6 seconds and replica-lag-time-max-ms of 10,000 milliseconds.
- Tune Zookeeper session timeouts from 6 seconds to 30 seconds and adjust group-initial-rebalance-delay-ms from 3 seconds to 0 seconds for low latency consumer group handoffs.
- Update controller.py to ensure that partition state machine transitions throttle concurrent leader reassignments to 50 partitions per second rather than unconstrained batch elections.
- Under no circumstances should any engineer modify the unclean-leader-election-enable setting to true, as that would risk catastrophic data loss across financial audit logs.

**Remediation:**
- Confirm that consumer applications utilizing the java client library implement backoff retries using exponential jitter starting at 200 milliseconds, capped at 500 milliseconds.
- Incident coordinators should review the runbook in docs/kafka_underscore_rebalance.md to verify that manual topic partition rebalancing commands specify explicit throttle rates.
- The observability team must establish automated Grafana alerts triggered when under-replicated-partitions count exceeds 0 for more than 3 consecutive minutes.
- Verify that all broker nodes emit jmx metrics to Datadog tracking active controller count and offline partition count with zero-second reporting intervals.
- The data platform engineering manager confirmed that all storage volumes must maintain 20% free disk space before resuming high throughput bulk ingestion pipelines.
- Network engineers must inspect edge load balancers to ensure tcp keepalive probes are enabled with an interval of 30 seconds and probe count of 3.
- Verify that consumer group heartbeat threads execute on dedicated high-priority CPU cores to avoid false positives during heavy garbage collection pauses.
- The billing ingestion pipeline must also configure consumer max-poll-interval-ms to 300,000 milliseconds to accommodate long running batch database transactions.
- Do not execute broker rolling restarts during peak business hours between 9 am and 6 pm Eastern time without vice president approval.

**Schema Registry Client Libraries:**
- Confirm that all storage volumes must maintain 20% free disk space before resuming high throughput bulk ingestion pipelines.
- Network engineers must inspect edge load balancers to ensure tcp keepalive probes are enabled with an interval of 30 seconds and probe count of 3.
- Verify that consumer group heartbeat threads execute on dedicated high-priority CPU cores to avoid false positives during heavy garbage collection pauses.
- The billing ingestion pipeline must also configure consumer max-poll-interval-ms to 300,000 milliseconds to accommodate long running batch database transactions.
- Do not execute broker rolling restarts during peak business hours between 9 am and 6 pm Eastern time without vice president approval.

**Data Governance Team:**
- Site reliability engineers will execute simulated broker failure drills in staging next Tuesday morning to validate that partition rebalancing completes in under 45 seconds.
- The backup and disaster recovery team must confirm that mirror maker 2 replication lag between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below 2 seconds.
- Log segment compaction threads must be configured with min-cleanable-dirty-ratio set to 0.5 to avoid excessive disk IO during active hours.
- Client application connection pools must enforce idle connection timeouts of 60 seconds to prune orphaned TCP sockets.
- The platform security team requires mutual TLS authentication between all producers and brokers using certificates issued by our internal vault PKI.
- Incident leads must also ensure that post-incident action items are tracked in Jira with assigned engineering owners and target completion dates within 2 sprints.

**Migration to Kraft Consensus Architecture:**
- Inspect kraft.properties in the metadata directory to confirm that controller-quorum-voters lists all 5 dedicated Kraft controller nodes across independent rack topologies.
- Verify that metadata log replication segment size is configured to 64 MB and metadata snapshot interval is set to 1 hour.
- All transactional producer applications must enforce enable-idempotence set to true with transaction-timeout-ms configured to 30,000 milliseconds.
- In addition, the JVM runtime flags on all broker instances must pin the g1 garbage collector with max-gc-pause-millis set to 20 milliseconds and initiating-heap-occupancy-percent set to 45 percent to eliminate stop the world latency spikes during active partition movements.
- Tiered storage offloading must be enabled for all historical topic partitions older than 48 hours streaming compressed segments directly to encrypted S3 buckets.
- The data governance team mandates that topic deletion operations require dual authorization signatures in the cluster administration portal.
- Finally, schedule a comprehensive architectural readiness review for Friday morning at 10 a.m. with the infrastructure director to audit all verified configuration diffs and authorize rollout to the production cluster.
